fillInstructions.description: The removed white '6' should be filled by the same orange badge interior, continuing a smooth radial/diagonal orange gradient that is slightly lighter toward the upper-left and slightly deeper toward the lower-right, with no new shapes introduced.
continueEdges: Continue the badge’s internal orange gradient seamlessly through both the outer digit stroke area and the inner hole of the '6'
Preserve the uninterrupted circular shading flow centered within the badge; no hard edges or outlines should pass through the fill
fillInstructions.texture: Clean, flat graphic fill with very subtle compression softness; no distinct texture or pattern.
